contentPattern.structure: heading + description + 'more' link (text-only card, no image)

suitableFor: text-only support/related-topic card grids where each card has a heading, a short description, and a single 'more'/read link
'More support' / 'see also' link-card grids on informational and help pages
uniform imageless cards that each navigate to a detail page via a per-card link
notSuitableFor: photo teaser cards with a thumbnail image (use cards-teaser)
text-only stat/benefit tiles with no per-card link (use cards-feature)
icon + short label product/category link grids (use cards-product)

usage.notes: Help-support money-management 'More support' section (#basic-18374 .grid, on a pale mint/teal bg-fino section): a 2x2 grid of four white text-only pods (Debt support / How to stay safe online / Cost of living support / Mental health support), each with an H3 heading, a description paragraph, and a per-card 'more' link with a circular-arrow icon. No thumbnail images. Differs from cards-teaser (requires images) and cards-feature (no per-card link).
